add-a-note: Add a note to your reply
add-a-session-sub: One-off — the standing schedule keeps running alongside it
announcements-empty-editor: Nothing posted yet. Use this for schedule changes and reminders.
archive-failed: Could not reach the archive. Try again.
ask-failed: That did not go through. Try again.
ask-no-replies: Which sessions has nobody replied to?
ask-unreachable: Could not reach the assistant. Check your connection.
ask-whos-confirmed: Who's confirmed for the next game?
assistant-blurb: It can read the sessions, the replies and the announcements on this page. It can’t change anything — use the buttons for that.
blurb-generated: Written by AI from the notes below.
cancel-vs-delete: Cancelling keeps the session on the board and tells subscribed calendars it is off. Deleting removes it here but leaves it sitting on anyone’s phone who already synced.
copy-failed: Could not copy — select the link and copy it manually.
err-end-before-start: The end time must come after the start time.
err-generic: That did not save. Try again.
err-network: Could not reach the server. Your change was not saved.
err-rate-limited: Too many changes at once — give it a moment.
err-server: The server had a problem. Your change was not saved.
err-too-long: A session cannot run longer than {{hours}} hours.
feed-url-warning: Anyone with the feed URL can read the schedule, so treat it like the page itself.
load-failed: Couldn’t reach the server — showing the last version loaded.
loading-slow: Still loading — the connection looks slow.
loading-very-slow: Taking longer than usual. The page will fill in as soon as it lands.
mark-read: Mark as read on this device
need-webhook: Add a webhook URL before turning reminders on.
notes-placeholder: What we're picking up, what to prep, who's bringing what…
nothing-booked-editor: Add a session to get started.
offline-banner: You’re offline. You can still read the schedule; changes won’t save until you’re back.
page-lede: Times below are in your timezone, with Central in parentheses.
pick-answer-first: Pick an answer first to add a note.
recap-empty-future: Nothing here yet — this is where the write-up goes afterwards.
recap-empty-past: Nobody has written this one up yet.
recap-placeholder: What the party did, who they met, what went wrong…
recap-summary-note: Summarised by AI from the notes below.
reminders-help: On the morning of each session, the channel gets the time, the place and who has replied. Nothing is posted for a cancelled session.
reschedule-note: Keeps the same length and tells the table. Use Edit for anything else.
roster-empty: Nobody has answered yet. You would be the first.
sign-in-to-reply-or-edit: Sign in to reply or edit this session.
subscribe-blurb: Subscribing keeps it in sync — edits here show up on your phone without re-importing.
thinking-long: Nearly there — long answers take a moment.
unlisted-note: This page is unlisted — anyone with the link can read it, and anyone signed in can edit.
webhook-help: In Discord: Channel Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → Copy Webhook URL.
webhook-saved: Saved: {{masked}}. Leave the field blank to keep it.
